notes.title: The Pepper Prince Episode 1 Goes Free
notes.content:
Hello friends,

We hope you are all safe and well. The recent outbreak of the coronavirus has affected all of us, and like you, we are stuck at home alone, bored and unable to go out. To still keep our collective sanity, people are coming up with all sorts of ways to stay connected and distracted. In that spirit, we decided to make the first episode of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1 free. We hope it can provide a fun little distraction during these difficult times.

We also just released a new free title, [url=https://hypnoticowl.com/games/everything-is-awful/]everything is awful but at least we have each other[/url], a surreal dating sim which you can play right now on [url=https://hypnoticowl.itch.io/]itch.io[/url]. Many more of our internal prototypes, experiments, and jam games will be made available for you to play over the coming weeks too, so be sure to check our [url=https://hypnoticowl.com/]website[/url] or subscribe to our [url=https://hypnoticowl.com/newsletter/]newsletter[/url] to stay up-to-date with the new things we're putting out!

So enjoy, stay safe, and let's get through this together!

<3 Hypnotic Owl

notes.title: Episode 2: The Sadness out now!
notes.content:
Happy Easter everybody: [b]The Sadness[/b] is here!

As the story kicks into gear, you'll be faced with greater challenges and more complex puzzles as you discover new and unexplored worlds - and perhaps even learn the art of putting two items together to create something new! 😱

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34136777/dec02f17d024bf6bad7fb6d7133c0a97837d5e26.png[/img]

We've also taken this opportunity to introduce a couple of improvements and tweaks for Episode 1: Keyboard navigation, expanded default responses, more clarity in certain character interactions, as well as smaller bug fixes and rebalancing of achievements. All in all, the changes are minor and likely hardly noticeable - no need to go back!

But now it's time to continue on with your quest, to tend to your friend in need and help him heal his broken heart!

Enjoy The Sadness!

notes.title: Episode 2 Release Announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that The Pepper Prince Episode 2: The Sadness will be released on [b]April 22nd[/b]!

And as a special Thank You to our supporters, owners of the Seasoning Pass get early access to the episode. Like, today! You can actually go play right now! Whoop whoop!

notes.title: Wot I Think: The Pepper Prince Episode One
notes.content:
Developer: Hypnotic Owl
Publisher: Hypnotic Owl

Release: Out now
On: Windows
From: Steam
Price: 3, $3, 3

On one hand, there’s the excruciatingly bad poetry. On the other hand, poo jokes. This is the dilemma I face when attempting a coherent position on my opinions of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1, the first in an episodic adventure series created entirely from ASCII art. Oh, OK, and the fact that despite being very cute, it’s 45 minutes long and without challenge.

(more…)
